tests.scope: source-isolated synthetic factor core, train adapter, parent binder, and FIT bundle semantics

prior_blocker_disposition.missing_receipt_bound_loader: UNRESOLVED: the outcome-blind parent binder exists, but no source-closed analysis authority or one-use exact-byte tensor loader exists.
prior_blocker_disposition.provenance_dropped_at_adapter_output: PARTIALLY_REPAIRED: FitTrainingInput carries all named identities, but their authenticity is not sealed and the parent binding can be stale.
prior_blocker_disposition.forgeable_owner_topology: REPAIRED: canonical owner order and the exact per-source group vector are recomputed and enforced.
prior_blocker_disposition.role_capability_not_sealed: PARTIALLY_REPAIRED: the factory exposes only 229 training documents, but no private one-use capability owns construction and the public dataclasses remain directly constructible.

blocking_defects.finding: fit_parent_binding_without_tensor_load reads receipt, terminal, authority, bundle, and manifest once, performs later source/audit checks, and returns without terminally replaying those artifact records. A synthetic bundle mutation during historical-source validation produced a returned binding with the old bundle SHA while the live bundle had a different SHA.

No source-closed transaction freezes factor-analysis authority before bundle deserialization, stable-loads the exact receipt-bound bundle bytes once, joins full bundle and manifest semantics, calls the train adapter privately, poisons the payload capability, and publishes a receipt-last analysis result or failure.

The parent binder and adapter do not bind an exact amended SOURCE_PATHS family or require an independent audit artifact. This audit records hashes, but no production source consumes or validates them.

FitArtifactBinding.from_parent_binding does not recompute binding_sha256 from the parent-binding body, and FitArtifactBinding is publicly constructible. The train adapter checks type and selected joins only, so arbitrary receipt, manifest, and bundle identities can be supplied outside a sealed loader.

required_repairs: Terminally re-read exact receipt, terminal, authority, bundle, and manifest records after historical source/audit validation; recheck failure and lock absence immediately before returning the parent binding.
Make parent-binding logical-hash replay mandatory and mint the artifact binding only inside a closure-private, one-use loader capability.

Implement and source-close the pre-deserialization analysis authority, exact BytesIO weights-only loader, full semantic joins, train-only adapter call, capability poisoning, and receipt-last/failure lifecycle.
Bind the amendment, preregistration, core, adapter, parent binder, FIT semantic dependencies, all relied-on tests, and this independent audit in the executable source closure.
claim_boundary: The train-only reducer and canonical owner topology are reusable infrastructure. This audit authorizes neither FIT factor analysis nor validation/EVAL access.
